title: About
content:
Honoring a Visionary Legacy

Fellini Forever is a curatorial initiative dedicated to preserving, interpreting, and celebrating the visionary legacy of Italian filmmaker Federico Fellini. Rooted in the belief that cinema is both art and memory, the Fellini Forever collection offers a profound exploration of Fellini’s creative universe, his imagination, process, and lasting influence on Italian cinema and visual storytelling.

The Collection

Originating from Fellini’s Cinecittà Studio in Rome, the archive encompasses an extraordinary range of original materials: film reels, production sketches, costumes, photography, set designs, and personal belongings such as his director’s chair, signature hat, and writing desk. Each artifact serves as a tangible reflection of the maestro’s artistic journey and his lifelong pursuit of beauty, fantasy, and human truth.

Film Heritage, Cultural Dialogue and Education

Through curated exhibitions, educational programs, and community collaborations, Fellini Forever transforms historical preservation into an active cultural dialogue. The collection not only safeguards cinematic history but also invites audiences, scholars, and emerging artists to engage with Fellini’s world, to rediscover his genius and reimagine his legacy for future generations.

A Living Tribute

More than an archive, Fellini Forever is a living tribute to creativity itself. It stands as a space where memory meets imagination and where the spirit of Fellini continues to inspire those who believe in the transformative power of film.

title: Fellini Forever

There is no end. There is no beginning.

There is only the infinite passion of life. — Federico Fellini

A retrospective collection of personal artefacts and frames from Federico Fellini's Cinecitta Studio in Rome, Italy. Fellini Forever boasts a broad collection of historical artifacts that will be curated for community experiences and educational programming.

"At the center of it all, there was one director whom everyone knew, one artist whose name was synonymous with cinema and what it could do. It was a name that instantly evoked a certain style, a certain attitude toward the world. In fact, it became an adjective. Let’s say you wanted to describe the surreal atmosphere at a dinner party, or a wedding, or a funeral, or a political convention, or for that matter, the madness of the entire planet—all you had to do was say the word “Felliniesque” and people knew exactly what you meant. In the Sixties, Federico Fellini became more than a filmmaker. Like Chaplin and Picasso and the Beatles, he was much bigger than his own art. At a certain point, it was no longer a matter of this or that film, but all the films combined as one grand gesture written across the galaxy. Going to see a Fellini film was like going to hear Callas sing or Olivier act or Nureyev dance. … Fellini was the cinema’s virtuoso.”

Martin Scorsese, Harper’s, March 2021

The Fellini Forever Mission

The Fellini Forever collection boasts impressive stories, and footprints of Federico Fellini's passion and creative output.

Fellini Forever is dedicated to preserving and celebrating the extraordinary legacy of Italian filmmaker Federico Fellini. Through its extensive collection of personal artifacts, film reels, original drawings, and photography, the initiative brings Fellini’s creative vision to life. By offering online education, live events, film retrospectives, and community experiences, Fellini Forever inspires and connects new generations of filmmakers, artists, and enthusiasts with the magic of Fellini’s work.
